title: pilosella tubulata
intro: Pilosella tubulata, commonly known as Field Mouse-ear or Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is native to Europe and Western Asia, and is known for its medicinal properties. Pilosella tubulata is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, combat infections, and protect cells from oxidative damage. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
